A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ANaGRAM research and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and appendices A–E. Corresponding content can be matched despite reformatting and appendix reorganization.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original PINN optimizer comparisons with error, loss, and runtime measurements. Appendix A includes statistical results and Burgers-equation experiments.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A report original optimizer comparisons and Burgers-equation experiments, including numerical statistics, training curves, and solution profiles.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–2 retain the same Jacobian/SVD update, singular-value cutoff, and line search. The PINNs compound-model construction and treatment of correction terms are unchanged; Table 17 explains the existing construction.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate 2D and 5D Laplace, 1+1D heat, and 1+1D Allen-Cahn equations. Appendix A.4 retains the same Burgers problem with viscosities 1, 0.1, 0.01, and 0.001.

E2.justification: The main experiments compare ANaGRAM against E-NGD, GD, Adam, and L-BFGS in both versions; the Burgers experiment remains ANaGRAM-only. Newly cited methods are not added to the experimental comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices A.1/A.4 retain the same network architectures, collocation grids, iteration budgets, cutoff settings, initialization, line-search interval, and error/test-loss evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The Burgers viscosity and failure analysis, NTK/NNTK visualizations, and Green's-function illustrations are retained. The NTK/NNTK material moves from Appendix C.4 to C.5 without adding or changing an analysis.

E5.justification: Both report medians, interquartile shading, minima/maxima, and means with standard deviations. The stated ten initializations and three-initialization exceptions for E-NGD on 5D Laplace and Allen-Cahn are unchanged.

E6.justification: All 240 numerical entries in the runtime tables and Tables 1–16 match. Figures 1–22 retain identical plotted content, and the associated performance trends and Burgers failure finding are unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix C.2 adds formal kernel and integral-operator definitions, refines Theorem 3, and expands Theorem 4 with an explicit projection proof. Appendix C.3 corrects Proposition 2's derivative step by evaluating the derivative on theta_1 (v2 Equation 89). These are localized mathematical refinements; the principal ANaGRAM and Green's-function results remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: reduced-complexity empirical natural gradient, its PINNs reformulation, and the Green's-function connection. The principal accuracy and computational-cost claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of line search, kernel localization, linear versus nonlinear problems, and Burgers shock/grid failure. The limitations concerning collocation-point selection and manually chosen cutoffs are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5 replaces the anonymous code-access link with a GitHub repository link. Appendix A.1 retains the same software, hardware, numerical precision, initialization, and implementation information.

R1.justification: V2 adds Dangel et al. (2025) on K-FAC for PINNs, Cai et al. (2019) when identifying vanilla ANaGRAM with Gram-Gauss-Newton, and Adcock and Huybrechs (2019) for synthesis-operator terminology. These refine attribution and positioning without substantially rewriting the research context.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized language and terminology edits, updates author information, and adds acknowledgments. The definitions listed in v1 Section 4.1 are reorganized and expanded in new Appendix C.4, while the former C.4 becomes C.5; the overall narrative remains stable.

P2.justification: The document-wide conversion to the ICLR layout changes title/header styling, margins, text width, spacing, and figure/table placement. Several appendix plots are resized, and new full-page Table 17 presents the classical-regression/PINNs correspondence. Existing experimental graphics are reused unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 improves the theoretical exposition through explicit definitions, a fuller projection proof, and the corrected derivative step in Appendix C. Table 17 makes the existing PINNs adaptation easier to follow, and added citations improve attribution. These provide a limited quality gain; the algorithms, experimental evidence, and principal conclusions remain unchanged.
